verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents handling multi-state tax requirements, all associated federal, state, and local filings and payments, and automatic tax calculation. It also supports companies with work locations across multiple states, plus per-employee state tax configuration during onboarding, so the core of multi-state payroll with per-state withholding is covered. missing for 10: explicit documentation of state tax registration/account setup per state, detail on how per-state withholding rules are applied (e.g., reciprocity, local taxes), independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state payroll runs.
